1. Tap Thermo-Alchemist: it deals 1 damage to the opponent. (Opponent at 9)
2. Cast Shock (R) targeting the opponent, but **hold priority** — Shock stays on the stack. Thermo-Alchemist untaps (cast trigger); Dynavolt Tower gives you {E}{E} (2 energy).
3. Tap Thermo-Alchemist again: 1 damage. (Opponent at 8)
4. Cast Brutal Expulsion ({2}{U}{R}) choosing **both modes**: "Return target spell or creature to its owner's hand" targeting your own Shock on the stack, and "deal 2 damage to target creature" targeting Indulgent Aristocrat (3/3). It resolves: Shock returns to your hand (never resolving), and Aristocrat takes 2 damage (still alive at 3/3 with 2 damage). Thermo-Alchemist untaps; Tower gives {E}{E} (4 energy).
5. Tap Thermo-Alchemist again: 1 damage. (Opponent at 7)
6. Recast Shock (R) targeting Indulgent Aristocrat: 2 more damage — Aristocrat (3/3 with 4 total damage) dies. Thermo-Alchemist untaps; Tower gives {E}{E} (6 energy).
7. Tap Thermo-Alchemist a fourth time: 1 damage. (Opponent at 6)
8. Pay {R}: Weldfast Monitor gains menace until end of turn.
9. Tap Dynavolt Tower, pay {E}{E}{E}{E}{E} (of your 6): it deals 3 damage to the opponent. (Opponent at 3)
10. Declare Weldfast Monitor (3/2, menace) as attacker. The only creatures that could block it are Kalitas (Hinterland Drake cannot block artifact creatures), and since menace requires two or more blockers, Monitor is unblockable. Monitor deals 3 combat damage. (Opponent at 0 — dead.)

Mana used: Shock (1) + Brutal Expulsion (4) + Shock (1) + Monitor's menace (1) = 7 mana, exactly the 7 lands available (Fumaroles provide the {U}).
Total damage: 4 (Thermo-Alchemist) + 3 (Dynavolt Tower) + 3 (Weldfast Monitor) = 10. Opponent never deals damage, so lifelink never triggers for them, and they have no mana or cards to respond with.
